messages.最大7枠の広域で沈潜・振動を撒いて振動爆発を起こし、次のターンは「縛られし王の前: A heavy-cost Blunt E.G.O that spreads Sinking and Tremor across up to 7 targets and triggers Tremor Burst, then on the next turn uses Before the King in Binds to make his own skills effectively multi-target.
messages.7枠広域(解析Ⅳ): 解析Ⅳで攻撃加重値が7になり、多数の敵へ沈潜4・振動4・振: **7-target (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: At Threadspin Ⅳ, Attack Weight becomes 7, applying 4 Sinking, 4 Tremor, and Tremor Burst to many enemies at once.
messages.「縛られし王の前へ」: 撃った次のターン、攻撃加重値が1のスキルが的中すると、体: **Before the King in Binds**: On the turn after firing, when a skill with 1 Attack Weight hits, it deals damage of the same affinity to the 2 enemies with the lowest HP (100% of the damage). Before Threadspin Ⅳ, it is Before the King at 50%. If a skill's original Attack Weight is 1, it likely triggers even if its Attack Weight increases during combat.
messages.束縛の代償: 同じ次のターンに束縛20(速度が20減少)も得るため、マッチは取り: **The cost of Bind**: On that same next turn, he also gains 20 Bind (−20 Speed), making Clashes hard to win. He does gain Attack Power Up.
messages.精神力の減少: 撃った後3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10減る。: **SP loss**: For 3 turns after firing, he loses 10 SP at each Turn End.
messages.沈潜・振動を広く撒いて敵を混乱させ、次のターンは加重値1のスキルを一方攻撃で当て: Spread Sinking and Tremor widely to stagger enemies, and on the next turn land skills with 1 Attack Weight as one-sided attacks to rack up the effect damage.
messages.必要資源は色欲2・憂鬱4・傲慢2・嫉妬3の11個と重い。資源の確保が前提になる。: It requires a heavy 11 resources: 2 Lust, 4 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 3 Envy. Securing resources is the premise.
messages.侵蝕スキルは、味方2名にも束縛20と攻撃威力増加を付ける。: The Corrosion skill also gives 2 allies 20 Bind and Attack Power Up.
messages.Ⅱ: 「拘束の鎖」が解放される(自分を含む共鳴が4以上だと、共鳴内の味方の攻撃・: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Chains of Binding (with a Resonance of 4 or more including himself, allies in that Resonance gain Offense and Defense Level).
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が7になり、「王の前へ」が「縛られし王の前へ」に強化される。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 7, and Before the King is upgraded to Before the King in Binds.
messages.ワイルドハント: S2(嫉妬)・S3(憂鬱)・守備(色欲)で資源を出せ、S2(追: **[Wild Hunt](persona:0710)**: S2 (Envy), S3 (Gloom), and his Defense skill (Lust) supply resources, and S2 (Memorial Procession) inflicts Sinking and has increasing Attack Weight, likely making it easy to rack up the next turn's effect damage.
messages.南部ウーフィ協会3課: S1(嫉妬)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)で資源を出せ、振: **[Öufi Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0708)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Pride) supply resources, and he inflicts Tremor, laying the groundwork for this E.G.O's Tremor Burst.
